QUOTE: "It rebuilds the post with a new timestamp and `failed: false`, updates the local record so the UI shows it as pending again, and then calls `client.createPost` once more." and "On failure it sets `failed: true` again, or removes the post if the error is one of the three terminal errors above. Each tap is one more attempt; nothing repeats on its own."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states retryFailedPost makes one new createPost attempt with no automatic repetition, and on failure re-marks failed or removes for the three errors.
